definitions.explanation: A circular chart divided into sectors to show proportions of a whole. A fundamental type of data visualization used in education, business, and media.

examples.japanese: {結果|けっか}を{円|えん}グラフで{示|しめ}す。
examples.english: Show the results in a pie chart.

examples.japanese: {円|えん}グラフを{見|み}ると、{食費|しょくひ}の{割合|わりあい}が{一番|いちばん}{大|おお}きい。
examples.english: Looking at the pie chart, food expenses make up the largest proportion.

examples.japanese: プレゼンテーションでは、{売上|うりあげ}{構成比|こうせいひ}を{円|えん}グラフにして{説明|せつめい}した。
examples.english: In the presentation, I explained the sales breakdown using a pie chart.

notes:
Composed of {円|えん} (circle) + グラフ (graph, from English). One of the basic chart types taught in Japanese schools and widely used in business presentations and news media.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {円|えん}グラフで{表|あらわ}す — to express in a pie chart
- {円|えん}グラフを{作成|さくせい}する — to create a pie chart
- {円|えん}グラフの{割合|わりあい} — the proportions in a pie chart

RELATED WORDS:
- {棒|ぼう}グラフ — bar chart
- {折|お}れ{線|せん}グラフ — line graph
- {帯|おび}グラフ — stacked bar chart
- グラフ — graph, chart (general term)
